item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 7 (remaining portion): Block 7's heights now follow the Design for Development's colour-coded labels: a 240 ft maximum with an 85 ft base in the north-west part and 85 ft elsewhere (the earlier '150 ft base' was a plan dimension). The unit list no longer includes 315, which is Block 8's figure on the Planning Commission slides, and the 27-story and 325-unit figures are attributed to SF YIMBY rather than the slides. The design review application date now follows Planning's memo (December 19, 2020). The expected completion moved from 2028 (a press figure) to 2029, the end of Phase 1's schedule in the October 2020 approval, and is marked soft because earlier 2020 forecasts did not hold. 'Market-rate rental' now says the developer anticipates rental units. The Foster + Partners rendering was removed because the plan sheets are marked as copyrighted by the architect; the design review packet remains cited. The dead 2019 draft link was replaced with the final February 2020 document and the Fifth Space rename no longer carries a year.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 7 (remaining portion): Board of Supervisors passes the Amended and Restated Development Agreement (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770) on first reading; Legistar's history lists '9/29/2026 ... Board of Supervisors ... PASSED, ON FIRST READING ... Pass' for both. Legistar also lists 'Final action: 10/6/2026' and status 'Mayors Office', but the 10/6/2026 history row's action and result read 'Not available' and the enactment date and enactment number are blank, so enactment is not confirmed. All dates are legislative event dates as listed by the Clerk of the Board (page read October 12, 2026) (Sep 29, 2026)
